name: Launch readiness
action: Confirm booking links, UTMs, event listings and the two approved creative angles.

name: Organic booking baseline
action: Keep paid media off and learn the natural Resolution booking pace.

name: Controlled paid test
action: Run EUR 70 Meta + EUR 30 Google; compare response without committing the remaining budget.
primary_measure: Sales pace, CTR, LPV, verified purchases if available

name: Conditional scaling
action: Release budget only for screenings below the healthy curve and only into evidence-supported channels/areas.

name: Show-specific recovery
action: Use EUR 8-25/day only on the Tuesday that needs help; stop promotion when a show is near full.
